description: Method calls through getAttribute() with named and spread arguments (P33): CoreExtension::getAttribute() calls `$object->$method(...$arguments)`, and ZEND_SEND_UNPACK checks every named element against the parameters of the called method as it sends it (zend_handle_named_arg()), so the method's real parameter list decides the error (Object::method_params()). Userland test classes, the __call() trampoline, internal SPL classes, enum cases, Twig\TemplateWrapper and Twig\Markup. Vectors with known_mismatch still differ.

known_mismatch.reason: The date classes of twig-date (DateObject: DateTime, DateTimeImmutable; likewise DateTimeZone, DateInterval, DatePeriod) give no parameters through Object::method_params(), so getAttribute() unpacks with CallArgs::from_spread() and reports the positional element first; PHP checks the unknown named element against the arginfo of DateTime::format(string $format) as ZEND_SEND_UNPACK sends it (zend_handle_named_arg(), PHPSRC/Zend/zend_execute.c): `Unknown named parameter $zz`. Fix: implement method_params() for the twig-date objects (P33 follow-up, G5).
